title: Buyers REMORSE IS REAL- Don't be misguided and know all of your options!
description:
Buyers- Don't be misguided and know all of your options! Buying a home is one of the biggest financial decisions most people make in their lives, so know what you can get, whats affordable, whats the best rate, closing costs you need to have (or can have the seller pay), inspections needed, appraisals ordered....
